sql.orgType.getAllForCompany: select ot.*, parent.org_type as org_parent_type from flow.org_type ot left join flow.org_type parent on parent.id = ot.org_parent_type_id where ot.company_id = :companyId order by level nulls first, org_type
sql.orgType.getOne: select ot.*, parent.org_type as org_parent_type from flow.org_type ot left join flow.org_type parent on parent.id = ot.org_parent_type_id where ot.id = :id
sql.orgType.updateOrgType: update flow.org_type set org_type = :orgType, org_parent_type_id = :orgParentTypeId, level = :level where id = :id
sql.orgType.insertOrgType: insert into flow.org_type(org_type, org_parent_type_id, level, company_id) values (:orgType, :orgParentTypeId, :level, :companyId)
